note: The taxonomy ledger (D424, shaped by D425). A lane that meets a question fitting no existing category PARKS it here instead of dropping it, and scripts/topic-budget.mjs decides from this file whether the gap has become a category. What stays fixed is the You map's RING — its hubs (the owner, 2026-09-08: 'the amount of topics shown at the top in the You map should stay roughly the same unless a new one is really needed, but learn, feed, daily can all get new topics'). A new topic on any surface lands in a hub that exists (`group`); a subtopic is the cheaper shape when the questions are a part of a topic that exists. Written by lanes through their own PR; read by npm run topic:budget; held honest by check:taxonomy. Empty is the correct state when no lane has met an unfittable question — proposals accumulate, they are not seeded. Retirement (D426) is the path out: a room is FOLDED into another, never deleted — a row in `retirements` is a proposal, a row in `retired` is done, and check:taxonomy fails a retired id found at any site.

shape.leaf: { id: 'sub_<slug>' (feed) | '<slug>' (learn), level: 'leaf', label, surface: 'feed' | 'learn', parent: <a topic or subject id>, retag: [existing feed question ids under the parent that are this leaf's — free stock], questions: [{ prompt, options?, run: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }] }
shape.top: { id, level: 'top', label, surface: 'daily' | 'feed' | 'learn', nearest: <the existing category it came closest to>, group: <daily: a hub id in map-groups.js; feed: a WF_BRANCH target — a CAT_META key or a hub label; learn: omit, Knowledge by prefix>, questions: [{ prompt, options?, run: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }] } — a proposal that can only land in a hub that does not exist holds for the owner
shape.created: { id, level, label, surface, parent?, createdAt: 'YYYY-MM-DD', pr }
shape.retirement: { id, level: 'leaf' | 'top', surface, parent? (a leaf's), into: <where the questions go — a feed leaf: its parent; a learn field: a field of the same subject; a top: a top of the same surface>, reason, owner?: 'YYYY-MM-DD' (the owner's word, which licenses any level), run }
shape.retired: { id, level, surface, into, retiredAt: 'YYYY-MM-DD', pr, licence: 'thin' | 'silence' | 'owner' }

surfaces.daily: top = cat[0], a key in CAT_META (src/v2/spec/daily-cats.js); the second level is the free path cat[1] — written on the question, never created
surfaces.feed: top = an id in WORLD_TOPICS (src/v2/spec/world-feed-topics.js) and in content/feed-questions.json topics; leaf = an id in WORLD_SUBTOPICS (src/v2/spec/world-subtopics.js), carried by a question as `sub`
surfaces.learn: top = a subject in content/learn-questions.json; leaf = a field there, carried by a card as `f`
